newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Short-term mark, lira plays.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Short-term mark, lira plays.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest trade ideas featured Euromarks and Eurolire.

Sanwa International said historically the mark curve steepened after a repo rate cut but eventually adopted a flatter bias. Statistical data showing a healthy German economy point towards repo rates remaining the same.
Therefore Sanwa recommended switching into Austria's 6.00 percent bond due February 2006 from Italy's 7.25 percent bond due February 2006, as a long-term recommendation.

San Paolo believed the Bank of Italy will cut the discount rate by 125 basis points before the year and that such a move is not priced in. It recommended staying at the short end to take advantage of any further streepening.
** Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters** EUROLIRE

STRATEGY The sell side of this switch is expensive against the swap at 18 b.p . through the swap compared to the buy side which is cheap at 7 b.p. through the swap and only 5 b.p. through the BTP. This switch is also attractive as both bonds trade on a 25 b.p. bid offer spread.
STRATEGY GEC offers almost the same duration and yield pick-up of around 22 b.p. It is also cheaper against the swap at 16 b.p. through compared to the World Bank at 31 b.p. through.
STRATEGY Eurofima is cheap at only 8 b.p. through the swap and it offers around a 22 b.p. pick-up in yield.
STRATEGY These bonds are cheap against the swap and are still liquid assets.
STRATEGY This bond is cheap against the swap at 12 b.p. through and cheap against the BTP at only 14 b.p. through. EUROMARKS
SRATEGY The Bund curve will start to flatten in time as

demonstrated by historical data following a repo rate cut. This is also fuelled by statistical data showing the German economy is growing at a healthy pace. This means rate cuts will be less likely in the future.
This switch offers a yield pick-up of 266 b.p. which is at the upper end of the six-month range (239-255 b.p.) and Austria is rated Aaa compared to Italy at Aa3. EURODOLLARS

STRATEGY This bond is currently at a spread of 66 b.p.over the 10-year benchmark. It is expected to perform well as the weekend saw the Quebec premier announce he intended to remain in office for the full term putting off the prospect of another referendum on independence for at least this period.
